---
title: "BioFAIR Pathfinder 2026"
---

This is a Quarto website for the BioFAIR Pathfinder project [Connecting Bioconductor, Galaxy, and nf-core](https://biofair.uk/updates/2026/biofair-pathfinder-projects-launch-with-800k-to-transform-uk-fair-practices/).

The notebook [Clustering 3K PBMCs with Bioconductor](./tutorial-singlecell-bioconductor/) illustrates a single-cell analysis workflow combining several R packages from the [BioConductor](https://bioconductor.org/) and [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/) repositories. It is intended to support discussions around potential updates to existing Galaxy tool wrappers and to help identify cases where new wrappers may be needed.

To learn more about Quarto websites visit <https://quarto.org/docs/websites>.
